name: OsmosisProofling-Bench-Gaokao-TK
description: OsmosisProofling-Bench-Gaokao-TK is a dataset of Gaokao-style exam questions intended to evaluate model performance on high-school/college entrance level Chinese exam tasks. It measures factual knowledge, reasoning, and problem-solving ability on standardized Gaokao items (often multiple-choice). The benchmark is used to assess how well models perform on educational, exam-style questions in Chinese.
reputation: A niche benchmark focused on Chinese Gaokao questions with modest adoption by researchers working on Chinese-language evaluation.
